title: Amla Fruit Powder for Herbal Hair Packs, 200 g
descriptionHtml:
Amla Fruit Powder for Herbal Hair Packs. A botanical ingredient for a traditional hair-care routine. Net quantity: 200 g.

Amla is traditionally valued in Ayurveda. Here, its role is an external-use herbal hair pack prepared and rinsed according to the product directions. It can be chosen as a separate pack step in a hair-care routine.

Ingredient studies use different preparations, including extracts and oral products. They do not establish softness, shine, reduced breakage or hair regrowth from this powder. Facial and body-pack use remains a development option pending assessment of the actual product's suitability, tolerance and directions.

Best suited to

  • Traditional herbal hair-pack routines
  • People choosing a fruit-based botanical hair-pack ingredient

How to use

  1. Preparation: Read the pack directions and test a small area before first use. Mix the required powder with clean water in a clean bowl.
  2. Hair: Apply according to the hair-pack directions, avoiding eyes and irritated scalp. Do not extend the stated application time.
  3. Rinse: Rinse thoroughly using the method on the pack. Use your usual hair-care products afterwards if needed.
  4. After use: Prepare only what you need and discard leftover wet paste.

Use with care

  • For external use only. Test on a small area before first use and stop if irritation occurs.
  • Avoid eyes, lips, broken or irritated skin and breathing in loose powder.
  • Strand-test light, grey, bleached, porous or colour-treated hair.
  • Facial and body-pack suitability has not been established for this powder. Follow hair-use directions only.

Storage

Keep sealed in a cool, dry place. Always use a clean, dry spoon.

title: Reetha Cleansing Powder for Herbal Hair Washes, 200 g
descriptionHtml:
Reetha Cleansing Powder for Herbal Hair Washes. A soapnut ingredient for a botanical wash routine. Net quantity: 200 g.

Reetha fruit shells contain naturally occurring saponins. Laboratory studies of soapnut preparations support a washing role; they do not establish the cleansing performance or tolerance of this finished powder. Prepare and rinse according to the product's hair-wash directions, keeping the mixture away from your face and eyes.

Natural foam does not prove mildness or sensitive-skin suitability. Body-wash and household-cleaning uses are separate development options requiring their own assessment. This cosmetic powder is not a treatment for acne, fungal infections or dandruff.

Best suited to

  • Rinse-off hair cleansing
  • Wash-day routines
  • People familiar with botanical hair washes

How to use

  1. Preparation: Test on a small area and follow the pack quantities. Mix with clean water into the consistency directed on the label.
  2. Hair: Work gently through wet roots and lengths, keeping the mixture away from your face and eyes.
  3. Rinse: Rinse thoroughly without leaving the mixture on longer than the pack directs. Follow with your usual conditioner if needed.
  4. After use: Discard leftover wet mixture and keep the dry powder container sealed.

Use with care

  • For external use only. Test on a small area before use.
  • Keep away from the face and eyes; saponins can sting. Rinse with plenty of water if contact occurs.
  • Do not apply to broken or irritated skin. Stop use if irritation occurs.
  • Avoid breathing in loose powder. Face and body use has not been established for this product.
  • Natural foaming does not establish suitability for sensitive skin.

Storage

Keep sealed and dry. Avoid introducing water into the jar.

title: Shikakai Pod Powder for Traditional Hair Washing, 200 g
descriptionHtml:
Shikakai Pod Powder for Traditional Hair Washing. A botanical ingredient for a herbal cleansing routine. Net quantity: 200 g.

Shikakai pods have a history of use in hair-washing preparations. Use this powder in a rinse-off wash step, following the product's preparation, application and rinsing directions. Keep the mixture away from your face and eyes.

Studies of pod washes or formulated shampoos do not establish dandruff-treatment efficacy for this finished powder. Softness, detangling, mildness and after-feel are outcomes to assess through product testing. Facial and body-cleansing uses are not established for the current powder.

Best suited to

  • Botanical hair-washing routines
  • People exploring traditional wash-day ingredients
  • Rinse-off hair-wash routines

How to use

  1. Preparation: Test on a small area. Mix with clean water using the quantity and consistency on the pack.
  2. Hair: Work gently through wet roots and lengths without rough rubbing, avoiding your face and eyes.
  3. Rinse: Follow the pack timing, rinse thoroughly and use your usual conditioner if needed.
  4. After use: Prepare fresh each time and discard leftover wet paste.

Use with care

  • For external use only. Test on a small area before use.
  • Avoid eyes, lips, broken or irritated skin and breathing in loose powder.
  • Stop use if irritation occurs. This product is intended for hair cleansing, not facial masks.

Storage

Store tightly closed away from humidity and direct sunlight.

title: Bhringraj Powder for Traditional Hair & Scalp Packs, 200 g
descriptionHtml:
Bhringraj Powder for Traditional Hair & Scalp Packs. A botanical ingredient with an Ayurvedic hair-care heritage. Net quantity: 200 g.

This product uses leaves and aerial parts and is positioned for an external-use hair and scalp pack. Prepare a fresh mixture and follow the product's application and rinse-out directions. Ayurvedic hair-care use provides historical context, not proof of a clinical outcome.

Published hair-growth research uses extracts in animal studies, while some traditional references describe whole-plant preparations. Neither establishes regrowth, grey reversal, softness or scalp-comfort results for this finished powder. Facial and body use requires its own product assessment.

Best suited to

  • Traditional hair and scalp rituals
  • Rinse-off hair masks
  • People building a botanical wash-day routine

How to use

  1. Preparation: Test on a small area and mix with clean water using the pack directions.
  2. Hair: Apply the smooth paste gently to scalp and hair in sections, avoiding irritated areas.
  3. Rinse: Follow the pack timing, then rinse or cleanse thoroughly. Use your normal conditioner if needed.
  4. After use: Discard leftover wet paste and keep the dry powder sealed.

Use with care

  • For external use only. Test on a small area and stop use if irritation occurs.
  • Avoid eyes, broken or irritated skin and breathing in loose powder.
  • Strand-test light, grey, bleached or porous hair.
  • This cosmetic powder is not a treatment for hair loss or scalp conditions.
  • Facial and body-pack suitability has not been established for this product.

Storage

Keep cool, dry and sealed. Use a clean, dry utensil.

title: Hibiscus Flower Powder for Herbal Hair Packs, 200 g
descriptionHtml:
Hibiscus Flower Powder for Herbal Hair Packs. A floral ingredient for a botanical hair-pack routine. Net quantity: 200 g.

Choose this flower powder as an ingredient for a traditional external-use hair pack. Prepare it fresh and follow the pack's application and rinse-out directions. Protect fabrics and test a strand before use on light or porous hair.

Softness, shine, slip and other conditioning outcomes require testing of the actual product. Research on leaf mucilage or Hibiscus sabdariffa tea does not establish benefits for this Hibiscus rosa-sinensis flower powder. Face and body packs remain a development option pending suitability and tolerance assessment.

Best suited to

  • Traditional herbal hair-pack routines
  • People choosing a flower-based botanical hair-pack ingredient

How to use

  1. Preparation: Test on a small area and mix a fresh smooth paste with clean water, following the pack quantities.
  2. Hair: Apply according to the hair-pack directions, avoiding eyes and irritated scalp. Do not extend the stated application time.
  3. Rinse: Rinse thoroughly using the method on the pack. Use your usual hair-care products afterwards if needed.
  4. After use: Discard leftover wet paste and clean the bowl and any marked surfaces.

Use with care

  • For external use only. Test on a small area first and stop use if irritation occurs.
  • Natural pigment can mark skin, clothing and surfaces; protect fabrics and rinse well.
  • Strand-test very light, grey, bleached, porous or colour-treated hair.
  • Avoid eyes, lips, broken or irritated skin and breathing in loose powder.
  • Facial and body-pack suitability has not been established for this flower powder. Follow hair-use directions only.

Storage

Store sealed away from moisture, light and heat.

title: Indigo Leaf Powder for Botanical Hair Colour, 200 g
descriptionHtml:
Indigo Leaf Powder for Botanical Hair Colour. For a strand-tested botanical colouring routine. Net quantity: 200 g.

Indigo leaf powder has an established hair-colouring role. Final shade and grey coverage depend on the starting hair, preparation and colouring process. Follow the product's colour directions and test a strand before full application; no specific shade or coverage is guaranteed.

Some darker-colour methods require a suitable henna step. Henna is outside this six-product range, and Amla or Hibiscus does not replace it. Use any separate hair pack only after checking colour compatibility.

Carry out the directed allergy test before every use, wear gloves and keep the mixture away from eyes, eyebrows and eyelashes. Ingredient-level safety assessment is not product approval or a guarantee against reactions. Medicinal indigo naturalis is a different material and does not establish skin-treatment benefits for this leaf powder.

Best suited to

  • Scalp-hair colouring routines
  • People familiar with henna-and-indigo preparation
  • Users willing to skin-test and strand-test before colouring

How to use

  1. Before colouring: Read the full pack directions and carry out the directed skin test before every use. Test a strand to check shade and hair feel.
  2. Preparation: Follow a suitable colouring method. Henna may be required and is not included in this six-product range; Amla is not a substitute. Wear gloves and mix exactly as directed.
  3. Hair colour: Apply and rinse using the mixing and processing times on the pack. Do not extend the time or add unlisted ingredients.
  4. After use: Rinse thoroughly, clean splashes and discard leftover mixed paste.

Use with care

  • For external use on scalp hair only. Do not use for skin masks, eyebrows or eyelashes.
  • Carry out the directed skin test before every use; a clear test does not guarantee that a reaction cannot occur.
  • Indigo alone may appear blue or green on light or grey hair. Strand-test before full application.
  • Wear gloves. Avoid eyes, damaged or irritated scalp, inhalation of powder and contact with fabrics.
  • Stop and rinse if irritation occurs. Do not use if you have reacted to this product before.

Storage

Keep airtight, cool and dry. Protect from humidity and direct light.
